name: Broccoli Throw Meme AI Video
blurb: One photo in: your pet or you gets the broccoli, throws it over the shoulder, and the room blows up behind.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep them exactly as photographed: the same face, fur or hair, colours and build. (1) A hand slides a white plate piled with green broccoli florets in front of them; they look down at it and give it a flat, dead-serious stare. (2) They grab or swat the plate and fling it backwards over their shoulder, broccoli florets flying through the air behind them. (3) The moment the broccoli lands behind them, a huge fireball explosion fills the whole room, orange flames and grey smoke rolling past, while they stay sitting in front of the blast, completely unbothered, staring straight into the camera. Handheld phone camera, one continuous shot, vertical 9:16. Explosion boom and a heavy beat drop in the audio, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
